Then reason: the question stem states that the three rock cores A, B, and C were drilled along a straight line, so B can be regarded as the middle of this section, with A and C on the two sides. The rule for identifying fold structures is: when the central rock strata are newer and the two wings' rock strata are older, it is a syncline; when the central rock strata are older and the two wings' rock strata are newer, it is an anticline. In the figure, the strata of rock core B in the middle are newer, and A and C on the two sides are older, so this geological structure is a syncline.
